OpenAI-Compatible Images 1.0.1 protects local configuration and image artifacts from accidental Git tracking and adds a verified installation path for the versioned Codex Plugin archive.

## Highlights

- Adds a ready-to-use local marketplace to the Codex Plugin ZIP for version-pinned installation.
- Documents the Plugin ZIP download, checksum, extraction, marketplace, and installation flow.
- Creates or verifies a local `.gitignore` containing only `*` in user and project configuration directories.
- Applies the same ignore rule to configuration migration targets and the resolved image artifact directory.

## Install

Choose either the Codex Plugin or the Standalone Skill. Follow the [v1.0.1 installation guide](https://github.com/Syh1906/openai-compatible-imagegen/blob/v1.0.1/docs/guides/installation.md) for the Git-backed marketplace, Plugin ZIP, or Standalone ZIP flow.

Download `SHA256SUMS` from this Release and verify the selected archive before installation. Start a new Codex task or agent session after installing the package.

## Security

- Configuration tools never return stored API keys.
- Local ignore rules keep credentials, provider configuration, prompts, annotations, metadata, and generated images out of Git tracking.
- An incompatible ignore rule, symbolic link, junction, or unsafe output path stops the write instead of replacing local policy.

## Known limitations

- After switching Codex tasks, the side panel may return to the result card instead of the open canvas. Use **Continue editing** on that card to reopen the preserved draft.
